requirements.text: Allow students to colour-code their modules in personalised timetables
Enable students to hide cancelled classes in their timetables
Allow students to add personal study blocks in their timetables
Provide reminders for personal study blocks in timetables
Sync personalised timetables with external calendar apps like Google Calendar or Outlook
Send automatic notifications when new grades are posted
Send automated reminders for upcoming assignment deadlines and exam dates
Notify students of changes to their schedule, such as room changes or class cancellations
Notify students of upcoming feedback opportunities for module evaluations
Allow students to customise their notification preferences
Collect anonymous structured feedback from students after the teaching period
Gather feedback on content quality, delivery methods, and resource effectiveness
Ensure feedback is made available to module coordinators only after grades have been submitted
Integrate new features seamlessly with the existing portal authentication system
Avoid modifications to the current student records database schema
Maintain compliance with GDPR and university data retention policies for student data
Maintain overall performance of the portal without degrading existing functionalities
